_why: Role track for TOOL & DIE MAKING, authored under docs/profiling/role-pack-authoring-guide.md as part of Batch 2. fam_toolmaking stays the generic Tool and Die Making interview bound at ISCO unit 7222; this pack binds the NCO tool-and-die occupations directly (job_domain specificity 50 beats unit 40), so a press-tool maker gets tool-room depth and every other 7222 worker is untouched. The generic pack asks five questions -- what you make, drawing, tolerance, workplace, own tools -- which is the whole of a tool room's hiring stated once each. This pack is that hiring conversation.
_scope: THE TOOL ROOM, NOT ONE MACHINE. This role stands at a surface grinder, a wire-cut EDM, a sinker EDM, a milling machine and a bench in the same week, and the ratified sheet's machine row says exactly that. So the machine question is a multi_select over the tool room's equipment rather than a disambiguator, and the role's own identity question is toolroom_level -- Trainee, Tool Maker, Senior -- which is what the headline prints and what a tool-room advertisement asks for. tool-die-maker.role.ts declares that ladder and names toolroom_experience as this role's tenureQuestionKey; both are honoured here literally, because a renamed gate key would leave the sheet's years figure reading nothing on a worker handed the form on his first message.
_depth: THE TIER GATE IS toolroom_experience, asked FIRST. It cannot be experience_years from qp_universal: phase order runs occupation_specific BEFORE universal_tail, so the universal answer does not exist yet when these items are selected. Its options carry value_number ONLY. pack-registry.service.ts resolves valueText ?? valueNumber ?? valueBool, so adding a value_text would make the answer a STRING; every gte below would then compare a string to a number, compare() returns null, and the predicate is false forever. A permanently-false ask_if is a question that is never asked, silently -- the #776 defect that sat in qp_welding for the life of the pack. Every ask_if here uses the contract shape {op, left:{field}, right:{const}}, never {op, args}, which is the other half of that same defect.
_budget: MAX_ENGINE_ASKS is 28 and qp_universal spends 8. Tier 0 is 8 items (16 total), tier 1 adds 3 at gte 2 (19), tier 2 adds 4 at gte 5 (23). The three fresher items are gated on toolroom_experience <= 0 and a senior never sees them; a fresher skips tiers 1 and 2 entirely, so his worst case is 16 + 3 = 19. The tiers are mutually exclusive by construction, which is why the fresher branch costs the senior nothing. Worst case anywhere is 23 against 28.
_sheet: SECTION B IS READ OFF THE RATIFIED REFERENCE SHEET (Prakash Rathod, Tool & Die Maker -- Tool Maker), not invented. Its eight rows are Tooling made, Machines, Tool steels, Tool-room work, Measuring instruments, Drawings, Tolerance held and Sector worked, and every one has a question here that fills it. THE HEADLINE ROW IS Tooling made, not Machines: the ratified headline reads 'Tool & Die Maker -- Tool Maker, 9 yrs, Press tools, Progressive dies, Jigs & fixtures', which is toolsPhrase's three-value cap applied to that row. A tool-room advertisement is written in what the shop builds; the machines under it are shared with CNC Grinding and conventional machining and identify nobody. Tolerance is a BANDED single_select rather than a free number: the sheet prints a band, and a banded chip keeps a low-literacy worker tapping instead of typing while avoiding the answer_type 'number' path that has no Flutter widget.
_capture_only: FIVE ITEMS ARE CAPTURED AND DELIBERATELY NOT PRINTED -- edm_work, die_design_work, die_troubleshooting, heat_treatment_work and press_tonnage. They are real matching data landing on worker_attributes with full provenance, but the ratified page has no row for any of them and guide section 5b forbids inventing one. This is the programming_mode precedent from qp_cam_programming exactly. drawing_reading's 'none' is likewise omitted from the map, on the same ruling that governs the turner, the miller and the grinder: a worker's own marketing document is not where a negative claim belongs.
review_note: Drafted for owner review (Prakash). Shop-floor vocabulary NOT yet corrected by a practising tool and die maker -- see docs/registers/trade-content-ratification.md.
_fresher: Guideline section 11 #1: a fresher's Zone 4 is training, trade test, machines used in the ITI workshop and project work, and the History heading never renders empty. These three items are the ask half; resume-fresher-rows.ts, fed by this role's descriptor, is the render half, and it reads iti_workshop_machines and trade_test_status LITERALLY -- neither may be renamed. The workshop machine list is the TOOL ROOM's ITI bench, so it leads with fitting-bench work rather than with a lathe.
